\begin{definition}[Polynomial]\label{def:poly}
A polynomial over $\F$ is a finite sum $\sum a_i x^i$.
\end{definition}
\begin{lemma}\label{lem:roots}
A nonzero polynomial of degree $d$ satisfies
\begin{equation}\label{eq:deg}
\#\{x : p(x) = 0\} \le d .
\end{equation}
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
Induct on $d$ using Definition~\ref{def:poly}; % a trailing comment \ref{lem:bogus}
the base case is trivial.
\end{proof}
